correctness.rationale: From explicit O=Z[α], α²−α+2=0 period lattice Λ=O³, reduction mod2 is (F₂×F₂)³, splitting J[2] into H-stable 3-dimensional factors. Independent F₂ enumeration using the given action matrices yields group 168, the dual pairing P=[[0,0,1],[1,0,0],[0,1,0]], orbit sizes 1+7+7+21+28 and the sixteen complete addition-table rows. Source finite verifier additionally checks uniqueness of invariant alternating form (2 solutions among 2^15 possibilities), no nonzero invariant covectors, unique invariant quadratic refinement q=φ(v), and its 36 zeros/28 ones. The canonical H-invariant nondegenerate Weil form must be the invariant hyperbolic form. This is an exhaustive 64-vector finite mathematical claim; no extension to odd torsion.

Novel claimed content is explicit GL(3,2)-module V⊕V^∨, the Weil/evaluation and invariant quadratic structure, intrinsic decomposition and full 16-row fusion table, which neither the source’s orbit sizes nor invariant theta alone logically supply. Related Klein representation literature may encode it under alternate terminology; Resultary no direct hit.
